description: Walk recent activity across repos, Claude Code session transcripts, working dirs, and Drive — emit a synthesis ledger (human-readable markdown + machine-readable structured JSON) that captures who contributed what, what landed, what failed, and what's queued.

conductor_mode.description: User says 'synthesize the last 24h' or '...last 7d' or names a window. Claude walks phases conversationally, surfaces sources before walking, asks for permission on private sources.
user_invocation_examples: walk last 7 days across our work

dispatch_mode.description: Same standard via subagent dispatch · power-user surface for long windows / multi-repo walks.
dispatch_mode.tradeoff: dispatch_mode parallelizes the source-discovery phases (one subagent per source-class)

phases.name: discover
phases.intent: Diverge. Catalog all sources for the synthesis window: (a) git logs across registered repos, (b) Claude Code session jsonl under ~/.claude/projects/, (c) /tmp working dirs created in the window, (d) Drive doc index, (e) Slack channel history if permitted. Emit a sources_catalog. Refuses premature interpretation.

phases.name: cluster
phases.intent: Converge along author and lane axes. Group source-events by author, repo, and lane (architecture · math · review · etc). Emit a clustered view of the discover-phase catalog.

phases.name: synthesize
phases.intent: Generate the deliverables: (a) human-readable markdown with per-author contribution + landings + PR mentions, (b) machine-readable structured JSON for training feed. Both outputs cite the same source-event references.

rules: sources walked READ-ONLY · never edits source events
Claude Code session jsonl + /tmp + Drive read with explicit user permission per session
citations MUST credit source event ids · synthesis is not original content, it is derived
synthesis output is read-only once written
